gui_address.description: The IP address and port the Syncthing GUI listens on.

gui_tls.description: Whether to use HTTPS for the GUI.

gui_user.description: The username for the Syncthing GUI authentication.

gui_password.description: The password for the Syncthing GUI authentication.

local_discovery_enabled.description: Whether to announce this device to local LAN.

global_discovery_enabled.description: Whether to announce this device to the global discovery server.
